mission_create_request.title: Build Focus Ledger, an accessible local task checklist with persistence and tests
mission_create_request.description:
Create a small dependency-free static application in this assigned isolated worktree only. Do not modify the original checkout or any other source.
Deliver index.html, app.mjs, tasks.mjs, tests/tasks.test.mjs and evidence/result.md. No packages, network access, publishing, commits, background servers, browser launch or process termination are needed. Use native file tools for code and run node --test tests/tasks.test.mjs once when ready. Do not inspect account/credential files.
The page heading must be Focus Ledger. Provide a field labelled Task title, an Add task button, and a Show tasks select with All, Active and Completed options. The empty state is No tasks yet. Each task has an accessible checkbox named Complete followed by its exact title, and a Delete followed by its exact title button. Keep titles visible while completed.
Reject blank titles with an accessible error; trim titles and limit to 80 characters. Use a pure tasks.mjs model with at least six meaningful node:test cases covering blank/long titles, add, complete, deletion and filtering. UI state persists in localStorage; corrupt localStorage recovers to an empty list with a clear message.
Pressing Enter in the title field adds a valid task, controls have visible keyboard focus, and a 390px viewport must not overflow horizontally. No external assets. Use a responsive light theme.
Record actual tests and implementation limits in evidence/result.md. The runner separately executes the persisted verifier after your provider session ends. A later development-principal review gate remains separate from implementation. Return promptly when done.
